Project Submission for Circuit Breaker Hackathon by ETH GLOBAL
We wanted to use this as a learning oppportunity to learn abot ZKP

Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) are cryptographic protocols that enable one party, the prover, to convince another party, the verifier, of the truth of a statement without revealing any additional information beyond the validity of the statement itself. In essence, ZKPs allow for the verification of information while preserving the confidentiality of that information, thereby enhancing privacy and security in various applications.
